scientific_integrity: All displayed tail and mean formulas have self-contained analytic derivations; exact-rational tests are finite reproducibility checks and not proofs of universal quantifiers. No external independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes iid draws of subsets of size n-2 with equal individual omission marginals 2/n. No assertion for unbalanced draws or other subset sizes. The n=4 fastest case follows an earlier half-package stochastic-dominance theorem. Literature-based originality comparisons have residual coverage risk, including inaccessible Schilling (2021) full text.
title: Sharp stochastic bounds for balanced two-omission coupon collection
